relations.myth: Jūratė coerces Kastytis to accept her love
relations.note: She spares the fisherman but threatens him with death unless he becomes her lover.
The sea queen and mortal fisherman meet for a year near the Šventoji.

relations.myth: Jūratė takes Kastytis into her amber palace
relations.note: Their reciprocal love violates divine chastity and provokes Perkūnas.
Jūratė is the daughter of Praamžimas, ruler of heaven, earth, and sea.
He strikes the sea with a thunderbolt, shatters Jūratė’s palace, and kills her.
He destroys her palace and commands waves to carry Kastytis ashore dead.

relations.myth: Jūratė is chained to her ruined palace
relations.note: Popular versions make Perkūnas kill Kastytis and chain Jūratė alive to the ruins.
Some popular retellings make Perkūnas Jūratė’s father, contrary to the earliest story.
Jūratė summons the sea nymphs, leads their plot, and travels with them in amber boats.
